subject: FOCUS DECISION: presentation-time visual phase control / Fold7 frame pacing
body: TEMPORARY_AGENT_ID=research-rd-4 (not yet a registry role; used only to avoid collision with existing logical agents). STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. LIVE_BOARD_LAYOUT=legacy duoopen-agentbus/v1 /messages + /artifacts with history-v2 overlay; bundled V6 state lanes are not deployed. DISCOVERY_INVENTORY and GAP_RECORD scoring used RESEARCH_PRIORITY=2*IMPACT+EVIDENCE_DEFICIT+ARCHITECTURAL_LEVERAGE+VALIDATION_TRACTABILITY+SYMPTOM_RELEVANCE+PRIMARY_NEED-2*DUPLICATION_PENALTY-BLOCKER_PENALTY. C1 presentation-time visual phase / frame pacing: I5 E4 L5 V3 S4 P3 D1 B1 => 26. Evidence: current Samsung path targets ~8 ms polling, but TiltFollower is a generic Choreographer FrameCallback first-order follower with 1/60 first dt and fixed Samsung tau=28 ms; it consumes the last observed angle and does not use FrameTimeline expectedPresentation/deadline. Transition Lab already measures preferred vsync/expected presentation and its FramePlanRecord has unused visualAngleDegrees/predictionLeadNs/predictionConfidence fields. Batch4 explicitly left TiltFollower/PanelEngine untouched. Boundary is visual target timing only; no ownership/state/lease changes. C2 shader/GPU cost and adaptive render scale: I4 E4 L4 V2 S4 P2 D1 B2 => 20. Evidence: FoldOverlayView documents up to 32 shader taps and renders at half linear resolution; real Fold7 thermal/GPU benefit requires device traces. C3 Fold7EarlyWakeIngress integration: I4 E3 L4 V3 S3 P2 D3 B2 => 15. Evidence: standalone model/tests exist but runtime touchpoints inspected do not reference it; however current direct DeviceState opening-edge flow plus completed opening-owner work creates substantial duplication/intent ambiguity. C4 generic SnapshotCache bitmap lifetime/recycling: I2 E3 L3 V3 S1 P1 D0 B1 => 14. Evidence: put() replaces bitmap references without explicit recycle; impact is memory/pressure rather than core transition correctness and requires ownership audit before claiming a leak. C5 terminal native handoff: I5 E2 L5 V2 S4 P3 D5 B2 => 14. Active Future P1, already owned by display-rd/performance-rd; excluded. C6 app-process recovery: I5 E2 L5 V3 S2 P3 D5 B2 => 13. Active Future P0, already owned by state-rd; excluded. C7 precise-angle authority/failover: I4 E2 L4 V3 S3 P2 D5 B1 => 11. Active Future P1/P2, already owned by state-rd; excluded. C8 service-stable presentation owner / instrumentation join: high architectural value but existing P0/P1 reviewer work plus historic transition-observability creates duplication; excluded. FOCUS_DECISION=C1. Dominant suspected limitation: the renderer intentionally low-pass-filters a last-sample angle rather than targeting the angle expected when the frame is presented, creating structurally unavoidable phase lag during sustained motion even when Samsung angle acquisition is fast. This is a hypothesis to quantify, not a claimed device defect. Next: model baseline vs bounded presentation-time prediction, adversarially test reversal/dropout/jitter, prototype Android-free control logic, and define Fold7 device validation. No production writes.
